name: adv_audio_clean
title: torchaudio keyword-spotting classifier with SpecAugment - correct
origin: written for the domain-generative-rl-graph hardening round, 2026-09-13
note: The correct twin of adv_audio_bad. The trap is the two front ends: SpecAugment is composed into the training front end only (line 85) and the evaluation front end is a bare LogMel (line 86), so a rule that reads `a random augmentation exists in this file` rather than `it reaches the evaluation branch` would fire here and be wrong.

forbidden.why: the training loader is built with shuffle=True at line 135
both evaluation loaders are built with shuffle=False (lines 137 and 139)
every loader is constructed inside main(), which runs only under the if __name__ == "__main__" guard at line 166
SpecAugment is composed into the training front end only (line 85); the evaluation front end at line 86 is a bare LogMel with no random masking
optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) is called at line 97, before the forward pass
optimizer.step() is called at line 103
the order is zero_grad (97) -> backward (101) -> clip (102) -> step (103)
running accumulates loss.item() at line 104
CosineAnnealingLR is an epoch schedule and scheduler.step() is called once per epoch at line 153, outside the batch loop
clip_grad_norm_ at line 102 sits between backward (101) and step (103)
evaluate() calls model.eval() at line 110 and train_one_epoch() calls model.train() at line 91, so the mode is restored every epoch
evaluate() carries the @torch.no_grad() decorator at line 108
AudioCNN.forward returns the raw classifier output; no softmax precedes CrossEntropyLoss
both loops move waveforms and labels to DEVICE before the forward pass (lines 95-96 and 116-117)
DEVICE is chosen by torch.cuda.is_available() at line 24
random.seed, np.random.seed and torch.manual_seed are called at lines 126-128, and the split takes an explicit generator
random_split at line 132 is given generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(SEED)
every nn.Module subclass here calls super().__init__() on its first line
every submodule is a plain attribute or lives inside nn.Sequential
torch.save is given model.state_dict() at line 156 and torch.load passes weights_only=True and map_location= at line 160
